kit.title: One calm language for connected care
kit.lede: Tokens and primitives shared by every Amal Network screen. Arabic first, readable at the reception desk, steady in light and dark.
kit.demoNotice: Everything on this page is a local demonstration. Nothing is saved and no clinical data is read.

palette.intro: Raw brand values are preserved exactly. Text always uses a measured pairing of at least 4.5:1.
palette.goldNote: Gold is reserved for the logo and empty-state illustrations. It is never a status or action colour.

type.intro: IBM Plex Sans Arabic for both scripts. Line height 1.6.
type.bodySample: Each clinic keeps its own day; the network keeps the chart together so the next doctor starts informed.
type.receptionSample: Please confirm the phone number before printing the visit slip.

buttons.intro: Four variants, three sizes. Hover, pressed, focus, loading and disabled states all keep readable text.

inputs.intro: Labels are always visible. Errors are announced and never rely on colour alone.
inputs.name: Full name

status.intro: Six appointment states. Each pairs an icon, a semantic colour and a localized label.

cards.intro: Cards group related content on surface; radius 12 px. Dialogs use 16 px, controls 8 px.

b.title: Reception note
b.body: Keep the waiting area informed when a doctor is running late.

toasts.intro: Polite announcements by default; warnings and errors interrupt. Hover or focus pauses auto-dismiss.
toasts.successD: Demonstration only — nothing left this page.
toasts.dangerD: Example error with a retry action.

empty.intro: Every empty state explains why and offers the next step.
empty.title: No example items yet
empty.desc: Items you add here live only in this page and disappear on refresh.
empty.tipD: Empty states always offer a next step.

kit.footer: Amal Family Clinic Group · design foundation
